law: Onboard is the goal of every seat.
When a visitor goes deeper into a sector, onboard is good for that sector.
invert: If the figure will not invert, nothing is owed.
wet_ink: Crown wet-ink only. Targeted is not signed. A card is not a contract.
books: Stay on device. 127.0.0.1 echo. Dualis does not take the file.

nft.rule: Look-token is a receipt that you looked. Not a coin. Not a share. Does not trade. Stays on this device. Onboard remains the goal.

density_rule: Picture first. Gold ribbon = Goal · onboard · [sector]. Hint visible. Deeper waits behind the click.
